title: Yehovah Ma Deva – Samuel Finny Pachigalla Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: యుగ యుగములు నీవే మా ఏక దేవుడవు
english: yuga yugamulu neeve maa eka dhevudavu
intro: Yehovah Ma Deva is a beautiful Telugu Christian song that was released on January 14, 2024. It is written, tuned, and sung by Pastor Samuel Finny Pachigalla featuring Samy Pachigalla. The melodious music for the song is composed by Samuel Mories. This song was released on January 14, 2024 through Samy Pachigalla YouTube Channel.
